decks.notes: The deck focuses on controlling the game by using counterspells, removal, and powerful planeswalkers to shut down the opponent's game plan. It also utilizes the companion Kaheera to provide additional value and synergy with creature spells. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's color requirements and allow for flexibility in casting spells. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to maintain control of the game through disruption and card advantage, ultimately leading to victory through outlasting the opponent's resources.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays and disruption through hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Grief. The deck also utilizes powerful, efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker to apply pressure on the opponent. Feign Death and Undying Malice allow for recursion and protection of key creatures, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provides additional card advantage. The deck is designed to quickly overwhelm the opponent with early threats and disruption while maintaining a strong board presence.

The deck focuses on utilizing Cascade effects to cheat out powerful threats like Crashing Footfalls and Murktide Regent while disrupting opponents with counterspells like Force of Negation and Mystical Dispute. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with early aggression and value from Cascade triggers, putting pressure on them to respond quickly or be overwhelmed. Additionally, the deck includes versatile cards like Brazen Borrower and Subtlety for additional disruption and tempo plays. Overall, the deck aims to execute its game plan efficiently and consistently through its synergy of Cascade and disruptive elements.

This deck focuses on using Cascade cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst to quickly put powerful cards like Crashing Footfalls and Murktide Regent onto the battlefield. It also includes counter spells like Force of Negation and Subtlety to protect its threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a constant stream of threats while controlling the board with versatile spells like Dead / Gone and Fire / Ice. Boseiju, Who Endures and Otawara, Soaring City provide additional utility and protection for key spells.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays and disrupting your opponent's strategy with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief. By playing aggressively with cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Fury, you aim to quickly control the board and overwhelm your opponent. The deck also utilizes graveyard interactions with cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger to gain advantage. The inclusion of cards like Terminate and Fatal Push allows for removal of threats, while Feign Death and Undying Malice provide resilience to your creatures. Blood Moon is included to disrupt opponents' mana bases.

The main concept of this Combo - Hammer Time Modern deck is to quickly get out Puresteel Paladin and Colossus Hammer, allowing for a powerful, fast combo that can deal massive damage to the opponent. The deck also includes tools like Stoneforge Mystic and Sigarda's Aid to help search for and equip the necessary cards. With cards like Urza's Saga and Inkmoth Nexus providing additional support, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a lethal combination of equipment and creatures.

The focal point of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to quickly apply pressure on the opponent by playing aggressive creatures such as Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Orcish Bowmasters, while disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Terminate. The deck also aims to control the board with cards like Blood Moon and Fatal Push, while utilizing graveyard strategies with Dauthi Voidwalker and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger. Feign Death and Undying Malice help to protect key creatures and provide additional value. The deck's synergy and efficiency allow for fast-paced and brutal gameplay.

The main concept of this deck is to consistently cycle through your deck and control the board until you can cast Living End to bring all your creatures back from the graveyard. The deck focuses on using cards like Street Wraith and Architects of Will to cycle through the deck quickly, while also controlling the opponent's board with Force of Negation and Waker of Waves. Once you have set up your graveyard with creatures like Curator of Mysteries and Striped Riverwinder, you can cast Living End to overwhelm your opponent with a strong board presence.

This deck focuses on casting powerful cascade spells like Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent to cheat out impactful cards like Crashing Footfalls and Fury. By creating a fast and aggressive game plan, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Blood Moon and Force of Negation. With a mix of creatures and spells, the deck aims to create a fast and explosive board presence to quickly close out games before opponents can stabilize.

This deck focuses on assembling UrzaTron - Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, and Urza's Tower - to generate large amounts of mana quickly. It utilizes control elements like Oblivion Stone and Wurmcoil Engine to control the board while searching for win conditions like Karn Liberated and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds flexibility to the deck's mana base. Overall, the deck aims to disrupt opponents with its control elements while ramping into powerful threats to close out the game.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with cards like Utopia Sprawl and Lotus Bloom to cast powerful combo pieces like Tameshi, Reality Architect. Teferi, Time Raveler helps to protect your combo pieces, while Wargate and Eladamri's Call allow you to search for specific cards you need. The deck also includes some control elements with cards like Spell Pierce and On Thin Ice. Overall, the goal is to assemble the combo pieces and overwhelm your opponent with a powerful board presence.

The key concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruption spells in order to quickly deal damage and win the game. The deck focuses on utilizing cards like Grief, Ragavan, and Dauthi Voidwalker to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a fast pace with cards like Fury and Orcish Bowmasters. Feign Death and Undying Malice provide ways to protect key creatures and continue applying pressure. The inclusion of cards like Thoughtseize and Terminate help control the opponent's board while pushing towards victory.
